name: mastercam-mcp

tools.name: get_server_readiness
tools.description: Check local prerequisites, Mastercam connection, supported features, compatibility, and write-protection state in one report. Use this instead of combining the separate doctor, version, and connection checks.

tools.name: get_job_context
tools.description: Gather selected part, geometry, machine, stock, work coordinate system, post, operations, and referenced tools in one bounded report. Each section returns its source and availability; missing data is never filled in with guessed values.

sections.description: Choose which context sections to gather. Each section reports unavailable data explicitly.

tools.name: get_audit_history
tools.description: Read recent redacted safety events recorded by this MCP server, with their integrity status and whether collection is enabled. It does not include actions outside this server.

limit.description: Maximum recent audit entries to return, from 1 to 500.

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: List operations in document order with pagination and an optional type filter. Use find_operations when you have a name or tool-number criterion.

limit.description: Maximum operations to return, from 1 to 500.

offset.description: Number of matching operations to skip.

operationType.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter for operation types.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Retrieve one operation's mapped summary by exact ID, including its revision and fingerprint. No name or nearest-match fallback is used; use find_operations when the ID is unknown.

operationId.description: Exact Mastercam operation ID. No name or nearest-match fallback is used.

tools.name: find_operations
tools.description: Search operations by name text, operation type, or assigned tool number. Use list_operations when you need an unfiltered paginated listing.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against operation names or types.

operationType.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter for operation types.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return, from 1 to 200.

tools.name: compare_toolpaths
tools.description: Compare toolpath evidence for two exact operation IDs in the active document

beforeOperationId.description: Exact operation ID for the earlier toolpath.

afterOperationId.description: Exact operation ID for the later toolpath.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List tool records referenced by active operations. This is not a complete shop library or proprietary .TOOLDB reader; use the configured catalog for broader tooling recommendations.

limit.description: Maximum referenced job tools to return, from 1 to 500. This is not a complete .TOOLDB listing.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Retrieve one tool referenced by the active job using its exact ID, number, or unique name. Use list_tools for the job's referenced tool list.

toolId.description: Exact identifier, tool number, or unique name of a tool referenced by the active job.

tools.name: verify_change
tools.description: Reread one exact operation and compare its current feed and spindle values with expected values after an approved change. It does not verify toolpath regeneration or machine safety.

operationId.description: Exact operation ID to reread after a change.

feedRate.description: Expected feed value and unit after the change.

value.description: Positive feed magnitude. Interpret it using the explicit unit in this object.

unit.description: Feed unit: linear distance per minute or distance per spindle revolution.

spindleSpeed.description: Expected spindle value and unit after the change.

value.description: Positive spindle speed magnitude in the explicit unit in this object.

unit.description: Spindle speed unit. Currently only revolutions per minute is accepted.

expected.description: At least one expected feed or spindle value to compare with a fresh backend read.

documentRevision.description: Optional document revision captured by the preview/apply workflow; verification fails if the document changed.

transactionId.description: Optional transaction ID to link this verification result to the applied change.

tools.name: generate_setup_sheet
tools.description: Create a draft setup sheet from data supplied to this call. Omitted sections remain blank; use get_job_context first to gather available job data.

part.description: Part name, drawing reference, and other confirmed part details.

machine.description: Confirmed machine identity and relevant machine setup details.

stock.description: Stock dimensions and material, including explicit units.

wcs.description: Work coordinate system name and verified origin details.

operations.description: Operation records to include. Use get_job_context first when active job data is available.

tools.description: Tool records referenced by the included operations.

notes.description: Operator notes to include in the draft setup sheet.

tools.name: compare_nc_files
tools.description: Compare two supplied NC programs by sequence and supported modal changes. This is static review and does not replace a controller-specific simulation.

before.description: Earlier NC program text used as the comparison baseline.

after.description: Later NC program text to compare with the baseline.

tools.name: manufacturing_preflight
tools.description: Run deterministic programming preflight and return blockers, warnings, unknowns, and evidence without claiming machine safety

part.description: Confirmed part identity and relevant geometry summary.

wcs.description: Work coordinate system identity and verified origin.

post.description: Post processor identity and relevant settings.

operations.description: Operation records to check. Empty input is reported as a blocker.

tools.description: Tool records assigned to the supplied operations.

documentRevision.description: Source document revision for tracing this report to the inspected job.

verification.description: Evidence from separate verification tools. Do not set these flags based on a model's estimate.

simulationPassed.description: Whether an actual machine simulation was completed and passed.

collisionCheckPassed.description: Whether a collision check was completed and passed.

approvedPostBaselineAvailable.description: Whether an approved NC baseline is available for comparison.

tools.name: analyze_regeneration_impact
tools.description: Trace downstream operations from the dependency graph supplied in this call. It does not read or regenerate the active Mastercam job.

id.description: Stable operation ID used by dependencies and change references.

name.description: Optional operation name for readable impact reports.

dependencies.description: Exact IDs of upstream operations whose output this operation depends on.

toolpathDirty.description: Mapped dirty-state value, when known. Omit when the source does not establish the state.

operations.description: Operation dependency graph with exact IDs and downstream dependencies.

changedOperationIds.description: Exact IDs of operations changed by the programming edit.

tools.name: analyze_post_regression
tools.description: Compare supplied posted NC text with an approved baseline and rank recognized modal changes for human review. It does not simulate a controller.

after.description: Newly posted NC program text to compare with the approved baseline.

displayLimit.description: Maximum semantic differences to include in the response, from 0 to 1000.

tools.name: preview_operation_parameters
tools.description: Preview a feed or spindle edit on one exact operation and return a short-lived, single-use approval token. This step does not change the Mastercam document.

operationId.description: Exact operation ID to preview. No default or nearest-match target is used.

feedRate.description: New feed value with its unit, such as mm/min or in/min.

value.description: Positive feed magnitude. Interpret it using the explicit unit in this object.

unit.description: Feed unit: linear distance per minute or distance per spindle revolution.

spindleSpeed.description: New spindle value with its unit, such as rpm or surface speed.

value.description: Positive spindle speed magnitude in the explicit unit in this object.

unit.description: Spindle speed unit. Currently only revolutions per minute is accepted.

changes.description: Feed and/or spindle values to preview. At least one change is required.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional stable key to safely retry this preview request.

instructions: The compact toolset is active. Set MASTERCAM_MCP_TOOLSET=full to expose specialist inspection and analysis tools, or MASTERCAM_MCP_TOOLS to select a custom set. The tool list reflects the active server profile and hard-read-only setting. A selected tool appears only when both settings permit it. Fixture results are synthetic and do not prove live Mastercam behavior. Use get_job_context for a single bounded job snapshot. The report marks unavailable sections instead of treating missing data as zero. NC and toolpath analyses flag unknown motion and are not machine simulation. Mutations require preview_operation_parameters, explicit MCP client approval of the exact change, then apply_operation_parameter_preview with its approvalToken. Use verify_change to reread values and rollback_change with the transactionId if needed. plan_od_rough_finish is a non-executable preview.
